I think it's a case of hype coming ahead of the game. There's this great concept and some initial work, followed by loads of hype, followed by pressure to deliver the final product. Delivery then becomes the focus of development.

So we end up with:

-"Safe" mechanics and influences from successful franchises (in this case, GTA.)

-Novel concepts used to hype the game are actually underdeveloped.

-Sub-par writing: there's a good outline for a plot somewhere, but no time to give every individual dialogue due attention.
